"''My business is my own. Where is it?''"
«''Sit and enjoy a meal with us.|translated=1|The Ishi Tib and Din Djarin|}} An [[Ishi Tib]] was a '''guild master''' on the ringed [[space station]] [[Glavis Ringworld]]. Around [[9 ABY]], they hired the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] to bring in the [[Klatooinian]] [[Kaba Baiz]]. After Djarin took the [[Dismemberment|severed]] head of Baiz to the guild master, the Ishi Tib insisted he joined them and their party for dinner, but the Mandalorian asked the guild master to give him the information he was promised and left. ==Biography== {{Quote|Where is the closest access shaft to the substrata?''"
«''Sit and feast with us or I will tell you nothing.''»
"''You can keep your reward. There's a bounty on this Klatooinian.|Djarin and the guild master|}} The [[Ishi Tib]] was a guild master, residing on the ringed [[space station]] of [[Glavis Ringworld]] during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]]. Around [[9 ABY]],{{BoBFDate}} they hired the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] to capture the [[Klatooinian]] [[Kaba Baiz]] dead or alive, as the Klatooinian owed [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to the guild master. The guild master had also promised the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] information on where to find the access shaft to Glavis's substrata. The Mandalorian ultimately [[Death|killed]] Baiz and brought the his [[Dismemberment|severed]] head to the Ishi Tib at a lounge where they sat with six other delicacies. The guild master commended how fast Djarin had completed his job, the Mandalorian asking for his payment and the information he had been promised. The Ishi Tib insisted on the bounty hunter joining their meal, threatening to not reveal the information. Djarin, though, took back Baiz's head, claiming he could find another client to take the Klatooinian's bounty from. Giving in, the guild master revealed that the substrata could be access by the heat towers on Glavis's [[Kolzoc Alley]]. The Ishi Tib again asked Djarin to sit with their party, promising another job, but the Mandalorian recommended putting Baiz's head on [[Water|ice]] and left. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|If you won't give me the information, someone else will.''"
«''It's down Kolzoc Alley by the heat vent towers. Please sit. I have another job for you.''»
"''I'd put that on ice if I were you.|Djarin and the Ishi Tib|}} The Ishi Tib had [[Color|blue]] skin and brown [[eye]]s. They were insistent on Din Djarin feasting with them to give the bounty hunter another job, threatening to withdraw a promise of information. However, they ultimately caved when the Mandalorian threatened to give Kaba Baiz's head to other clients. ==Equipment== The Ishi Tib wore red and dark blue [[clothing]]. ==Behind the scenes== The Ishi Tib appeared in "[[Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian]]" of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]] and released on [[January 26]], [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}} The character was portrayed vocally by [[Helen Sadler]], with [[Safiya Fredericks]] being the performance artist. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *[[The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel|''The Book of Boba Fett'' Junior Novel]] *{{BOBF|Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-book-of-boba-fett-cargo-hold-chapter-5|text=''The Book of Boba Fett'' Cargo Hold: "Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian"}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Maestra del gremio ishi tib no identificada |fr=Maîtresse de guilde Ishi Tib non identifiée |ka=გილდიის უცნობი იში ტიბი ბატონი }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Ishi Tib]] [[Category:Space station residents]]
